_comment: Industry credentials shown on the counselor page (and reusable elsewhere). Researched 2026-09-07 from the issuers' pages and current exam guides; costs are the issuers' US list prices at that date and are labelled 'as listed'. `status` + `pairs` read as a sentence ("Built into AI 40"); `pairs` is the course the program builds the credential into or prepares students for: IBM in AI 40 and Microsoft in AI 40 are Vincent's; the rest read "Complements <course>" (Vincent, 2026-09-07: open, public resources students may meet alongside the program; no partnerships implied). `mark` is the short text shown in the brand tile (no logos: third-party logos need the owner's brand permission and would bring colours outside BRIEF §4). Update `checked` when a row is re-verified.

items.name: IBM SkillsBuild: Artificial Intelligence Fundamentals
items.what: A guided learning plan on AI concepts, machine learning, natural-language processing, computer vision and AI ethics, ending in a verified IBM credential a student can put on LinkedIn.

items.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Fundamentals (exam AI-901)
items.costNote: training free on Microsoft Learn; exam fee as listed for the US
items.what: The entry-level Microsoft AI certification, refreshed in 2026 as AI-901 (AI-900 retired June 30, 2026) with more weight on generative AI, Copilot and agents. Free study modules on Microsoft Learn cover the whole exam.

items.name: Google AI Essentials and Google Prompting Essentials
items.kind: Certificates (Coursera); free skill badges on Google Skills
items.costNote: Google Skills badges free; Coursera certificates $49 each as listed, free through Google.org for a limited time
items.what: Google AI Essentials covers using AI tools at work, prompting and responsible use; Prompting Essentials is a short five-step prompting course. Google Skills (formerly Cloud Skills Boost) also has a free Introduction to Generative AI path with badges.

items.name: OpenAI Academy courses and certificates
items.kind: Course-completion certificates; formal OpenAI Certification in pilot
items.costNote: courses and completion certificates free with a ChatGPT account; the formal certification is in pilot with partner organizations
items.what: Short courses on AI foundations, ChatGPT at work and agent workflows, each with a completion certificate. OpenAI's formal certification program is piloting with employers and universities and is expected to widen during 2026.

items.name: Anthropic Academy: AI Fluency and Claude courses
items.kind: Course-completion certificates; paid Claude Certifications for partner organizations
items.costNote: Academy courses and certificates free; the proctored Claude Certified exams ($99 and up) are open to Claude Partner Network organizations
items.what: A non-technical AI Fluency series (the delegation, description, discernment and diligence framework) plus builder courses on the Claude API, agents and Model Context Protocol. Each course ends in an Anthropic completion certificate.

items.name: AWS Educate: Introduction to Generative AI, and AWS Certified AI Practitioner
items.kind: Free training badge; proctored certification exam
items.costNote: AWS Educate and Skill Builder exam prep free; AI Practitioner (AIF-C01) exam fee as listed
items.what: AWS Educate issues a free Introduction to Generative AI badge and a learning pathway toward the AI Practitioner certification, which covers AI, machine learning and generative AI concepts on AWS. Fits beside COSN 250, the degree's cloud course.
items.statusNote: beside COSN 250, the degree’s cloud course
